- **Ammo as a 56px hero, one-row "Credits 900 · XP 0" currency block, "$" to SP on the bag line and scoreboard, contracts list max 3:** each one reverses one of your rulings or needs a call from you. The questions are in `questions.md`, and there is no answer yet.
- **Still possible, but small:** slot numbers at 16px, and merging "inbound" with "hostiles closing in". Neither would raise the critic's score.

I updated `notes/b-30-ui-hud.md` so a later run doesn't repeat this audit. The task can't reach 4 on any HUD screen until you answer the questions.
